status: DRAFT 2026-09-28 (rev. after E6_V1_DIAGNOSTICS.md) -- NOT FROZEN. Written before any v2 SLA/SVR/own-KPI outcome was run or inspected. Freeze = sol review + user go + [V] citations checked + hashes refreshed + seeds and rng tag registered in SEED_REGISTRY.json. Any change after freeze = new stack version + new contract.
relation_to_v1: Separate experiment after the predeclared gate-A kill of E6-scn-v1 + v1 xApps (scratchpad/e6_dev/GATE_A_RESULT.txt, scratchpad/e6_dev/decision/SOL_GATE_A.md). v1 FAIL stays published; a v2 pass does not validate v1.

stack.neighbour_relations: run-time ANR-like NRT per xApp from delivered mob (HO/RLF/ping-pong) and mr (border_all within 6 dB margin) reports; symmetric; starts empty; no removal; Layout.neighbours never read by v2 xApps
stack.knob_registry: CIO on all nc*(nc-1) ordered pairs + v1 non-CIO knobs (+ ll_ratio when SLICE); ric.py unchanged; env.py hooks described in spec sec. 2.3, not applied

fields: se_src / se_tgt (mean RSRQ-like SE estimate of active border UEs at source / target)
lowq_dwell (nc,nc): 1 Hz samples of UEs with serving SINR EWMA < Qout (-8 dB) while another cell is measured stronger, attributed to (serving, strongest other)

kpm_extension.rng: default_rng([seed, 6600, 7101, sec, j]) j=0 mr, j=1 mobq; parent KPM draws untouched (v1 bit-identical, tested)

MLB.GAMMA_meaning: required moved-UE rate gain se_tgt*kappa_n/(A_n+m) >= (1+GAMMA) se_src*kappa_s/max(A_s,1)
MLB.verification: rollback if first post-push mob window shows 0 HO attempts s->n, HO guard trips post-push, or neighbour degrades; pair blocked BLOCK_S

MROv2.fresh_window: 2 mob reports starting at/after the cell's last own applied change

v2_dev.use: mechanics/integration only; runner drops SLA/SVR/own-KPI fields

v2_gate_a_confirmation.use: gate-A rerun, v1 and v2 side by side on identical tapes; run once after freeze

v2_reserved.use: untouched until a v2 Gate B protocol is frozen

avoid.reason: v1 diagnostics block; Worker M registered 140000-140059 (v1_diagnostic_episodes); whole block avoided

gate_a_rerun.rule: UNCHANGED: PASS iff in surge or mistune (at every load of that scenario): min(TS alone, TS+MRO) mean SVR ratio <= 0.85 x freeze AND controllable fraction = (SVR_freeze - SVR_best_static_or_subset) / SVR_freeze >= 0.35
gate_a_rerun.computation: scratchpad/e6_dev/gate_a.py summarize() semantics, applied per stack
arms_per_stack: mistune: SMORestore alone (accept-all) and wrapped around TS+MRO
gate_a_rerun.identity_check: freeze under M4 == freeze under V2_M4 bit-for-bit on one seed, reported
gate_a_rerun.report: every seed/cell/arm/stack; v1 and v2 side by side; own KPIs; churn/ACK/rollback/action-mix; crashes count as noarb; no filtering, no reruns
gate_a_rerun.scoring_primary: WHOLE scored window (E6Env.score svr), v1 rule unchanged; declared before any v2 outcome
gate_a_rerun.secondary: SECONDARY (descriptive, never gating): same ratios on the event window from trace labels -- surge [t0, t_end], mistune [push_t, end]; separate table
gate_a_rerun.physics_ceiling: E6_V1_DIAGNOSTICS: capacity-limited 74-93 % of violated eMBB UE-s, CIO-relievable <= 3.5 %, mistune repair <= 7.4 % of violated UE-s -> gate A v2 may fail on physics regardless of xApp quality (spec sec. 7)
